source.note: The plan's own source (Kenney Space Kit `rover.glb`, zip pinned by sha256; no other library entry used this kit yet, so this pin is the first; the kit page currently links https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/space-kit/20874c75ac-1677698978/kenney_space-kit.zip). A small six-wheeled Mars-rover-style buggy: sloped nose with a hex camera lens, flat deck, a mast leaning back. Turned 180 degrees (`ingest.yaw`) so the sloped nose faces +Z. Height 3.3 m to the mast tip, which makes it 3.0 m long and 2.6 m wide, about Curiosity's length (body top at 2.1 m, near Curiosity's 2.2 m mast). Noon script for a warm martian/desert ground: hull cream (`moon`) over paper (`sky`), deck vermilion (`accent`) over dark brown (`iris`), chassis band paper over dark brown, tyres and mast flat dark brown (`iris` both tones: the script has no dark shade lighter than ink). Kept faceted (`smooth: false`), 172 tris. Static, no clips.
